title: Secret Store Management: governed, with no copy
lede: Privilege keeps an inventory of metadata. A read is checked against the policy, then the value is fetched live from the provider and handed to a consumer; it never rests in Privilege. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Policy engine (read and write are separate grants)
Provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, Delinea, CyberArk; mock)

steps.title: A read is requested
steps.what: {{castUser}} asks to read a secret. Read and write are separate actions to grant.

steps.title: Inventory: metadata only
steps.what: The inventory has the name, path, tags and versions. The value is not in it, anywhere.

steps.title: Policy decides
steps.what: With a read grant the request goes on; with only a write grant it is denied, with none the secret is not found.

steps.title: Fetched live
steps.what: Privilege authenticates to the provider with a connection credential that is sealed at rest, and fetches the value at that moment.

steps.title: Delivered, masked
steps.what: The value goes to the consumer (the gateway or an agent tool), never into an API response: the page says 'value delivered to the consumer (masked)'.

steps.title: Audited
steps.what: The read, allowed or denied, is in the audit trail.
